opening.argument: The speaker offers a $15 Fandango gift card and says the code will be revealed when the channel reaches 50 subscribers. Viewers are asked to subscribe for the free card, which the speaker describes as usable to book movie tickets online for pickup at a local theater. The requested action is a channel subscription, not payment, credentials, investment, or other financial participation. On the evidence provided, this is an ordinary gift-card promotion. Whether the code is ultimately revealed or the giveaway is authorized is not established.
